name: com.darhai/imap-mcp
title: Email (IMAP) - read, draft & send with your approval
description: Read your mail, write drafts, and send - but only after Дархай shows you the whole message and you press Send yourself. The model can propose; it cannot send on its own. Works with iCloud, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Bridge and any IMAP/SMTP host.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IMAP server hostname, e.g. imap.fastmail.com or imap.gmail.com.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: IMAP port. 993 for TLS, which is almost always right.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_USER
environmentVariables.description: IMAP username - usually your full email address.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App-specific password. Never your main account password. It stays on this machine and is never shown to the model.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false only for a local or plaintext server such as a test instance.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Outbound mail server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com. LEAVE EMPTY to keep the account read-and-draft only: without it the `email_send` tool refuses. There is deliberately no guess from the IMAP host.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Submission port. 587 (STARTTLS, the default) or 465 (implicit TLS).

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_USER
environmentVariables.description: Outbound username. Leave empty to reuse IMAP_USER, which is right at almost every provider.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Outbound app-specific password. Leave empty to reuse IMAP_PASSWORD. It stays on this machine and is never shown to the model.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false ONLY for a local bridge that terminates TLS itself (Proton Bridge). Otherwise encryption is required and a server that will not start TLS is refused rather than downgraded.

toolGroups.label: Send - only after you press Send
